'''Gavvix Sironna''' was an individual who served as a [[General/Legends|general]] in the [[Royal Alderaan Civil Fleet/Legends|Alderaanian military]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. After the [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] military was disbanded, Sironna taught the tactics of guerrilla warfare to several [[Aide/Legends|aides]], and subsequently sent them offworld to contact resistance groups.
